signal: The Aug 11-15 cluster shows a single throughline: AI is scaling by distribution, not just size — Gemini at 1B users via product integration, Muse Glimmer via single-GPU edge, Nova Act via managed browser automation, and Claude/Cursor via auto-mode agents on your own infra. The scarce resource is no longer model IQ but reliable deployment at scale, which is why infra (KV cache, datacenter buildout) and harness (durable state, routers) dominated the week's real releases.

top.title: Gemini hits 1B monthly users — Google's fastest-growing product ever
top.summary: Google confirmed Aug 11 that the Gemini app has crossed 1 billion monthly active users, making it the fastest-growing product in Google history. Google's product blog noted expanded connected-app integrations the same week, underpinning distribution via Workspace and Android.
top.why_it_matters: At 1B MAU, Gemini moves from model race to distribution race — product bundling and cross-app connectivity matter more than leaderboard deltas.
top.why_you_care: For your 'Products / AI-native UX' lens: observe how Google converts model wins into daily-use hooks. Distribution is the moat.

top.why_it_matters_zh: 说明 AI 规模化的新路径是 distribution（产品集成）而非单纯堆模型大小。对做 AI 产品的人，这是比参数竞赛更值得研究的增长范式。

top.title: Claude Code auto mode now default — Anthropic flips the agent switch Aug 14

top.why_it_matters: Defaults set behavior at scale: this is the largest live test of autonomous coding harness governance (permissions, sandboxing, observability) in production.
top.why_you_care: Directly hits your harness/runtime stack — compare Anthropic's auto-mode guardrails to your own agent permission design.

markets.summary_zh: 克利夫兰联储的 nowcasting 模型提供对 CPI 的近实时估算，帮助在官方数据前预判通胀路径与联储动向。
markets.why_it_matters_zh: 实用工具：比等 CPI 公布更快建立对利率与市场定价的体感。
markets.original_excerpt: Cleveland Fed nowcasting offers near-real-time CPI estimates ahead of official prints

world.title: US to tell partners they must pick sides in AI race with China
world.summary: Reuters reports (Aug 14) the US will press allies/partners to align on AI controls and supply chains in the contest with China — extending chip and model governance into diplomatic asks.
world.why_it_matters: AI supply chain and model access are becoming alliance politics, affecting chip exports and cloud availability.
world.why_you_care: If you rely on frontier GPUs or cross-border model APIs, this shapes access and cost.
world.title_zh: 美国将要求伙伴在中美 AI 竞赛中选边站
world.summary_zh: 路透称美国计划告知盟友与伙伴，需在 AI 竞赛中明确选边，涉及芯片出口与供应链合作。
world.why_it_matters_zh: 对科技供应链与 infra 供给有实质影响，可能重塑芯片与算力流向。
world.original_excerpt: US to tell partners they must pick sides in the AI race with China

world.title: Fed divided: benign CPI may force a hold, not a cut — Reuters
world.summary: Cooler inflation is paradoxically hardening a hold stance at a divided Fed, per Reuters Aug 14, as officials weigh sticky services and fiscal crosscurrents heading into September.
world.why_it_matters: Rate expectations anchor both tech valuations and AI capex financing costs.
world.why_you_care: Watch dot plot and Fed speakers into September for the next multiple move.
world.title_zh: 美联储内部分歧：温和 CPI 或指向按兵不动而非降息
world.summary_zh: 路透解读称尽管 CPI 温和，美联储内部仍分歧，按兵不动的概率不低于降息，需关注官员表态。
world.why_it_matters_zh: 市场定价在 hold vs cut 间摇摆时，科技股对利率最敏感。
world.original_excerpt: Fed divided as benign CPI may force a hold rather than a cut

world.title: White House national AI policy framework — bid for unified federal approach
world.summary: The White House framework pitches nonbinding recommendations for a single federal AI approach, aiming to preempt a patchwork of state laws and ease deployment complexity.
world.why_it_matters: A unified framework would lower compliance overhead for AI products operating across states.
world.why_you_care: Relevant if you ship an AI product in the US — affects your risk checklist.
world.title_zh: 白宫国家 AI 政策框架：寻求统一联邦路径
world.summary_zh: 白宫推出非约束性框架，建议以统一联邦立法取代各州分散监管，降低 AI 产品跨州合规复杂度。
world.why_it_matters_zh: 若落地，将直接影响你在美国发布 AI 产品的合规与部署清单。
world.original_excerpt: White House framework outlines nonbinding recommendations for unified federal AI regulation

for_you.title: Read this if auto mode scares you — design your harness before enabling autonomy
for_you.summary: Claude Code going auto-default is your cue to define permission tiers, filesystem fences, and rollback before you ship any autonomous loop — audit what auto would have done on your repo first.
for_you.why_it_matters: Autonomy without guardrails is a foot-gun; harness design is now the differentiator.
for_you.why_you_care: Exercise: list 3 disallowed actions and 3 auto-retry rules for your next agent.
for_you.title_zh: 若自动模式让你不安：先设计你的 harness 再开启自主
for_you.summary_zh: 单一推荐：读透 Claude Code auto 切换一文，明确何时让人介入、何时让 agent 自主，以及如何设计权限与回滚。
for_you.why_it_matters_zh: 把 autonomy 当作设计问题而非开关，是 harness 成熟度的分水岭。
for_you.original_excerpt: Design your harness before enabling autonomy — decide when to intervene and how to roll back

for_you.title: Save — NVFP4 KV cache as your long-context cost cheat sheet
for_you.summary: Bookmark the NVFP4 post. When you size your agent's memory window, this tells you how quantizing the KV cache changes dollars per long-horizon task — cheaper than shrinking context naively.
for_you.why_it_matters: You'll reuse it on every architecture review for agent cost.
for_you.why_you_care: Links your #5 Context window to #22 Cost/latency in one technique.
for_you.title_zh: 收藏：把 NVFP4 KV cache 当作长上下文成本速查表
for_you.summary_zh: 收藏 NVIDIA NVFP4 一文，作为你设计 agent 记忆/窗口策略时的成本参照。
for_you.why_it_matters_zh: 它同时连接了上下文工程与成本/延迟两个主题。
for_you.original_excerpt: Save the NVFP4 KV cache post as your reference for long-context cost

for_you.title: Distribution > model — what Gemini at 1B users teaches your product thinking
for_you.summary: Gemini's 1B MAU came from bundling into search, Workspace, and Android — not a bigger model. For your small-game idea, ask: what distribution surface already has your users?
for_you.why_it_matters: Solo builders win on distribution, not parameter count.
for_you.why_you_care: Prompt to sketch one integration wedge (e.g., Sheets plugin, Chrome side-panel) for your next prototype.
for_you.title_zh: 分发大于模型：Gemini 10 亿用户对产品思维的启示
for_you.summary_zh: Gemini 靠与 Search/Android/Workspace 的集成实现分发超越，提示 AI 产品的增长杠杆在 distribution 而非仅模型能力。
for_you.why_it_matters_zh: 对你规划 small-game/AI 产品的 roadmap 有直接启发：便宜的 router 模型 + 强分发。
for_you.original_excerpt: Gemini at 1B users signals distribution as the growth lever beyond model capability
